body.name: \(\mathsf E_5\)
body.construction: The observed variables \(X,Z,Y\) and latent roots \(U,T\) are binary. The roots are independent with \(P(U=0)=P(T=0)=1/2\). The arrows are \(U\to X,U\to Y,T\to Z,T\to Y,X\to Z,Z\to Y\), and the CSI is \(Z\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\perp}T\mid X=0\). In both models, \(P(X=0\mid U=0)=3/4\), \(P(X=0\mid U=1)=1/4\), \(P(Z=0\mid X=0,T)=1/2\), \(P(Z=0\mid X=1,T=0)=3/4\), and \(P(Z=0\mid X=1,T=1)=1/4\). In \(\rho^+_5\), every \(P(Y=1\mid U,T,Z)\) equals \(1/2\). In \(\rho^-_5\), every row with \(Z=1\) equals \(1/2\), while the \(Z=0\) rows ordered by \((U,T)=(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)\) equal \(53/100,53/100,57/100,1/4\). Complements give all unlisted binary probabilities. In both models, the observed table ordered by any \((x,z,y)\in\{0,1\}^3\) is \(P(X=x,Z=z,Y=y)=1/8\).
